name: nyrezone-mcp
description: Look up NYC tax lots and zoning districts: zoning, FAR, unused floor area, from public NYRezone data.
long_description: Gives your AI assistant read-only access to public NYC zoning data via nyrezone.com: lookup_lot (by address or BBL), get_zoning_district, and list_zoning_districts. No owner or personal data is returned. Informational only; not legal or architectural advice.
